Partly built

Corporate group with subsidiaries

A parent will set policies and budgets by unit; subsidiaries will inherit narrower rules; receipts will roll up the chain.

Partly built. Some of the steps below exist today and the rest are still to come. The lists at the bottom show which.

How it runs

  1. FactThe parent unit no tool neededSets policy packs and budgets by organisation unit.
  2. PlanSubsidiaries' assistants via modelInherit the policy; a unit can narrow it, never widen it.
  3. ReceiptThe operator console no tool neededConsolidates receipts up the chain.
What you get
Starts withAn organisation with units
StatusPartly built
Spend and results by unit, rolled up to the parent.

What it keeps to

  • A subsidiary's policy can only be narrower than its parent's.
  • A unit sees only its own rows.
